run_kmeans_clustering: run k-means clustering on feature data using FAISS and return cluster assignments and loss
run_pic_clustering: run Power Iteration Clustering on a nearest neighbor graph with Gaussian kernel and alpha damping
preprocess_features: preprocess feature data with PCA whitening and L2 normalization using FAISS
create_reassigned_dataset: create a PyTorch dataset with cluster pseudolabels from clustering results and image indexes
build_nn_graph: build a nearest neighbor graph from feature data using FAISS GPU index and return indices and distances
